description: Main cutting blade; plain edge on most models.
Fully serrated wavy-edge variant of the main blade.
Secondary small pen blade.
Small hawkbill-style pruning blade for cutting vegetation.
Blade with an integrated wire scraper for removing insulation.
Bottle opener with a large flat screwdriver tip and an integrated wire bender.
Can opener with a small flat screwdriver tip that also works with small Phillips screws.
Single tool combining cap-lifter, can opener, flat screwdriver and wire-stripper.
Flat blade for opening boxes with a small slotted screwdriver tip that also fits Phillips screws.
Short nail file with a nail-cleaner tip.
Wood saw for branches and general woodcutting; some versions include ruler markings.
Stainless steel metal file with fine saw teeth and a nail-cleaning tip; usable as both file and saw.
Stainless steel scissors.
Fold-out pliers with integrated wire cutters and a wire crimper in the jaws.
Fish scaler with hook disgorger and a ruler in cm and inches.
Magnifying glass for close-up inspection work.
Inline Phillips #1/#2 screwdriver with a 90-degree friction stop.
Fine straight-edge screwdriver for recessed terminal screws.
Bit driver using exchangeable hex bits (Phillips/Pozidrive, slotted, hex, Torx).
White in-line LED module with sliding on/off switch and momentary operation; powered by two replaceable 3V CR1225 cells.
Refillable butane gas lighter with piezoelectric ignition.
Stainless spatula for pharmaceutical and medical tasks.
Golf divot (turf) repair tool.
Tool for opening screw-off watch case backs.
Wrench fitting M3, M4 and M5 nuts.

Spatula for leveling and stirring coffee grounds in the portafilter, and for removing the filter basket.
12mm wrench for tightening or removing the steam wand tip of an espresso machine for cleaning or replacement.
Four-turn corkscrew for removing corks; can store the removable mini-screwdriver (excluded from this list).
#2 Phillips screwdriver; mutually exclusive with the corkscrew.
Reamer/awl punch with a sewing eye for punching holes and sewing.
Parcel carrier rated up to 200 lbs; also used as a puller and rope/lace tightener; some versions have an engraved nail-file on the spine.
Small 2mm flat screwdriver.
Dedicated narrow chisel.

Split-ring attachment point at the tail end of the knife.
